preconditions.description: Input contains two non-empty lines representing integers L and R.
L and R are positive integers with L <= R.
Input numbers do not contain leading zeroes.

postconditions.description: The output contains at least one block.

postconditions.expression: all(t_i >= 0 and c_i >= 1 for t_i, c_i in blocks)
postconditions.description: Each block has a non-negative level number and a positive count.

postconditions.expression: all(blocks[i][0] != blocks[i+1][0] for i in range(len(blocks)-1))
postconditions.description: Consecutive blocks have different level numbers.

postconditions.expression: sum(c_i for _, c_i in blocks) == m
postconditions.description: The sum of counts equals the total number of segments m.
The sequence of levels defined by blocks corresponds to a valid decomposition of [L, R] into minimal number of square-ten tree nodes.
